events.title: Lucky Dog Rise Demo is Out Now!
events.summary: Lucky Dog Rise Demo is Out Now! We’re very happy to finally say it: the Lucky Dog Rise Demo is officially out now! We’ve carefully prepared and adjusted the content for this demo, and we hope that even as a demo, it still offers a complete, relaxing, and enjoyable experience. We also deliberately chose the Mid-Autumn Festival as the release day for the Demo. The Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional holiday centered around reunion and spending time together. events.summary: Over the past little while, we’ve been inviting groups of players to try Lucky Dog Rise through our Playtest, and we’ve received a lot of helpful feedback along the way.Now, our little dog is getting ready for the next stage.We plan to release a public Demo for Lucky Dog Rise by September 25. events.title: Happy International Dog Day!
events.summary: A few Lucky Dogs dressed up for the occasion, so we thought we’d let them all come out and celebrate together.Lucky Dog Rise is currently in public Playtest on Steam, and we’re still adding more hats, outfits, and little details as the game grows.If you’d like a small dog buddy keeping you company on your desktop, you’re always welcome to join the Playtest.Hope every dog gets a little extra love today. ♥

events.title: Lucky Dog Rise Playtest — Testers Wanted!
events.summary: First of all, thank you for joining us and helping our little dog grow! We’re currently looking for testers to join the Lucky Dog Rise Playtest. If you enjoy desktop pets, collecting cosmetics, or simply want a little dog to keep you company while you work, study, or relax, we’d love to have you join us.
